title: Interior Design Studio London | Curated Design
metaDescription: A London-based interior design studio shaping distinctive residential, hospitality, and commercial spaces, from concept through completion.

hero.headline: Bespoke interiors to define your lifestyle.
hero.subhead: A London studio designing and furnishing homes and hospitality spaces end to end

process.heading: From first conversation to finished room.
process.closing: You bring the space. We carry it from brief to install.

steps.label: Brief
steps.title: Tell us about the space.
steps.text: Share the property, how you use it, and your timeline. If it helps, we can visit in person and take measurements before design begins.
steps.receive: a clear brief, with an optional site visit

steps.label: Concept & visuals
steps.title: See it before you commit.
steps.text: Layouts, a material palette, and photo-realistic visuals show exactly how each room will look and feel.

steps.label: Specification & cost
steps.title: Know the cost upfront.
steps.text: Every piece is specified for the property it sits in and set out in an itemised plan, priced openly before anything is ordered.

steps.label: Delivery & styling
steps.title: Walk into a finished room.
steps.text: We handle procurement, coordinate contractors and installation, then style the space down to the final object.
steps.receive: a procured, installed and styled space

servicesSection.heading: Full-service design from concept to completion.
servicesSection.lead: From early mood and space planning to specification and on-site coordination, we deliver quietly confident spaces tailored to the way you live.

collectionsSection.heading: Featured project.
collectionsSection.lead: A completed residential lobby refresh in Marylebone, shaped through architectural detailing, sculptural furniture, and layered lighting.

philosophy.heading: Quietly confident interiors with lasting impact.
paragraphs: We combine research, material sensibility, and careful proportion to create spaces that feel calm and complete—never loud, always liveable.
Our process is collaborative and thorough: listening first, then designing with intent. The result is a home or venue that reflects your values and supports your routines.

cta.heading: Have a project in mind?
cta.text: Tell us about your space and timeline—we’ll share how we can help.
